description: Source code for an Agent class managing reasoning, skills, communication, and lifecycle in a distributed AI system, including HTTP and serverless interfaces.

classes.name: TargetNotFoundError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling not found errors in target resolution.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: Main class managing AI agent lifecycle, reasoning, skills, communication, and integrations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Agent with configuration, sets up clients, registries, and default routes.

methods.name: reasoner
methods.description: Registers a reasoner handler with optional configuration.

methods.name: skill
methods.description: Registers a skill handler with optional configuration.

methods.name: includeRouter
methods.description: Includes external router into reasoner and skill registries.

methods.name: handler
methods.description: Creates an event handler for HTTP or serverless events.

methods.name: watchMemory
methods.description: Sets up memory watchers for specific patterns.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Discovers agent capabilities.

methods.name: registerMcpTools
methods.description: Registers MCP tools if configured.

methods.name: getAIClient
methods.description: Returns the AI client instance.

methods.description: Sends a note message via agent field client.

methods.description: Starts the agent server, registers with control plane, and begins heartbeat.

methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server and stops clients.

methods.description: Invokes a reasoner or skill by target string with input.

methods.description: Sets up default HTTP routes for health, discovery, reasoners, skills, and execution.

methods.description: Parses URL path to identify target name and type.

methods.name: normalizeInputPayload

methods.name: firstDefined
